scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal or their children
Applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year
Benefit can be availed only twice by a single beneficiary
Applicant must be studying Higher Secondary or above
Registration fee of ₹20 and yearly subscription fee of ₹30 are required; renewal fee of ₹30 after one year
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹30,000 per beneficiary for higher secondary and above education, with amounts varying by education level.
